title: The Fact That...
goal: Start a sentence with the fact and then comment on it, using el hecho de que + subjunctive.

sections.title: Unit 6, Lesson 4: The Fact That...
body: Sometimes you want to start with the fact itself and comment on it afterwards. Spanish does this with el hecho de que.
You will practise el hecho de que + subjunctive, the agreement of the comment and the way to say that a fact does not mean something.

items: I can start a sentence with el hecho de que + subjunctive and then comment on the fact.
I can say that a fact does not mean something, with el hecho de que... no significa que...
I can use the new words for facts and consequences.
